initial_static_findings_repaired: A parent-rejected acquisition could be reused because only worker and supervisor completion were checked. Acquisition now requires accepted parent receipts and exact artifact/source/declaration binding.
Build could start from a matching cache left by a failed configure. Build now requires the accepted configuration and exact cache/acquisition-inventory binding.
Child isolation retained DYLD_INSERT_LIBRARIES and other DYLD_* loader overrides. All DYLD_* variables are now removed in the child environment only.
additional_reviewed_guards: Required stage artifact inventory is exact and each artifact is hash checked.
Configure and build attempt markers prevent automatic retries with another receipt directory.
Real tiny-process controls cover clean exit, wall and sampled memory caps, observer failure, orphaned inherited descendants, group cleanup and leader reaping.
Archive traversal, escaping link chains, expansion limits, exact source root and payload hash mismatch reject.
limitations: RSS is sampled and applies to the inherited process group; brief peaks and arbitrary descendants escaping that group are not guaranteed contained.
Payload notice/architecture review and final built-runtime linkage inspection remain separate gates.
Driver correctness and a successful build do not establish mechanics or clinical validity.
